<h2>GPU Dev Accelerator Ultimate — Cross-Platform CUDA, Metal, and OpenCL Development</h2>

<p>
The most advanced JetBrains plugin for GPU programming. Write, debug, profile, and optimize CUDA, Metal, and OpenCL code in a unified, modern IDE environment — no more switching between fragmented tools.
</p>

<h3>GPU Language Support</h3>
<ul>
  <li>Full CUDA C/C++ syntax highlighting with kernel launch assistance</li>
  <li>Complete Metal Shading Language support for iOS and macOS</li>
  <li>OpenCL C syntax highlighting and kernel compilation</li>
  <li>Context-aware code completion for all GPU APIs</li>
  <li>Dedicated file types: .cu, .cuh, .metal, .cl</li>
</ul>

<h3>Debugging and Profiling</h3>
<ul>
  <li>Integrated cuda-gdb debugger with breakpoints inside GPU kernels</li>
  <li>Thread-level inspection and memory error detection</li>
  <li>nvprof and Nsight Compute profiling integration</li>
  <li>Flame graph visualization for performance hotspots</li>
  <li>Metal Performance Shaders framework integration</li>
</ul>

<h3>Optimization and Analysis</h3>
<ul>
  <li>AI-powered kernel optimization suggestions</li>
  <li>GPU memory leak detection with cuda-memcheck</li>
  <li>Occupancy analysis and warp divergence detection</li>
  <li>Multi-GPU topology visualization and workload distribution</li>
  <li>Real-time code inspections for GPU programming mistakes</li>
</ul>

<h3>Productivity Features</h3>
<ul>
  <li>CUDA and Metal run configurations</li>
  <li>GPU device information panel</li>
  <li>Keyboard shortcuts for compile (Ctrl+Alt+C), profile (Ctrl+Alt+P), and optimize (Ctrl+Alt+O)</li>
</ul>

<h3>Pricing</h3>
<ul>
  <li><b>Free:</b> Syntax highlighting, basic completion, and compilation for all GPU platforms</li>
  <li><b>Individual ($200–400/year):</b> Advanced debugging, profiler integration, AI optimization, memory analysis</li>
  <li><b>Enterprise ($500–2,000/year per seat):</b> Team collaboration, multi-GPU visualization, priority support, volume licensing</li>
</ul>

<h3>Requirements</h3>
<ul>
  <li>IntelliJ IDEA 2024.3+ or CLion 2024.3+</li>
  <li>NVIDIA CUDA Toolkit (for CUDA features)</li>
  <li>macOS (for Metal features)</li>
  <li>Java 17+</li>
</ul>
